incipit: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thine hot displeasure.
responsum: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am weak.
versus: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and darkness hath overwhelmed me.

incipit: O God, Which satest in the throne judging right, be Thou a refuge for the poor, a refuge in times of trouble.
responsum: For Thou alone beholdest mischief and spite.
versus: The poor leaveth himself unto thee; Thou wilt be the helper of the fatherless.

incipit: The Lord is at my right hand, I shall never be moved.
responsum: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoiceth.
versus: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance, and of my cup.

incipit: O Lord, Thou hast shown me the path of life.
responsum: Thou shalt fill me with joy in thy presence, at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
versus: Thou art He That shalt restore mine inheritance unto me.

incipit: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength; the Lord is my rock
responsum: And my fortress.
versus: My Deliverer, my God, mine Helper.

incipit: The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof
responsum: The world, and they that dwell therein.
versus: For He hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

incipit: Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
responsum: O my God, I trust in thee, let me not be ashamed.
versus: O keep my soul and deliver me.

incipit: O how great is thy goodness, O Lord
responsum: Which Thou hast laid up for them that fear thee!
versus: Which Thou, O Lord, hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

incipit: O God, be Thou my helper.
responsum: Neither leave me.
versus: Nor forsake me O God of my salvation.

incipit: I will bless the Lord at all times.
responsum: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
versus: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord; the humble shall hear thereof and be glad.

incipit: O God, give ear unto my tears; hold not thy peace, but, O, spare me!
responsum: For I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner.
versus: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me; O Lord, look upon me to help me.

incipit: The Lord hath set my feet upon a rock, and ordered my goings.
responsum: And He hath put a new song in my mouth.
versus: He heard my cry He brought me up also out of an horrible pit.

incipit: I said: Lord, be merciful unto me.
responsum: Heal my soul, for I have sinned against thee.
versus: Deliver me from all mine iniquities, O Lord.

incipit: Cut me not off in the midst of my sins.
responsum: Nor keep thy wrath against me for my latter end.
versus: Enter not into judgment with thy servant, O Lord.

incipit: My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready.
responsum: I will sing and give praise to the Lord.
versus: Awake up, my glory, awake, psaltery and harp! I will awake early.

incipit: Unto thee, O my Strength, will I sing, for God is my defence,
responsum: The God of my mercy.
versus: I will be glad and rejoice in thee, I will sing praise to thy Name, O Thou Most High.

incipit: In thee, O God, do I put my trust; let me never be put to confusion, O Lord deliver me in thy righteousness,
responsum: And cause me to escape.
versus: Incline thine ear unto me, deliver me speedily.

incipit: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise, that I may sing of thy glory, all the day long of thy greatness. Cast me not off in the time of old age;
responsum: Forsake me not when my strength faileth.
versus: My lips shall be fain when I sing unto thee.

incipit: My lips shall be fain when I sing unto thee;
responsum: And my soul, which Thou, O Lord, hast redeemed.
versus: My tongue shall also talk of thy righteousness, all the day long of thy praise.

incipit: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify thy Name for evermore.
responsum: For great is thy mercy, O Lord, toward me.
versus: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee; Thou art my God, and I will exalt thee.

incipit: Great, O Lord, is thy mercy toward me.
responsum: And Thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
versus: In the day of my trouble I called upon thee, for Thou hast heard me.

incipit: The Lord is my refuge.
responsum: And my God is the stay of my trust.
versus: He delivered me from the strongest of mine enemies, and the Lord was my stay.
